system.description:
Make an Interface Roll (12). Ona
success, mark a HP as you force your
Redline systems past safe limits,
dumping excess heat, neural overload,
aggression feedback, or unstable
cyberware output into a point within
Far range.
A violent pulse of thermal distortion,
pressure shock, sensor scream, or
overclock fallout fills the area within
Very Close range of that point.
Each target within the area marks 1 HP.
On a success with Hope, each target
within the area marks 2 HP instead.
